INSERT INTO identity_providers (id, org_id, key, kind, config, enabled, created_at,
                                         updated_at)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, '{}'::jsonb, true,
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                 timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
         ON CONFLICT (org_id, key) DO NOTHING
